discoveryMethod: separate first-party English and Spanish discovery plus bounded anonymous official viewer/configuration inspection
sourceReview: Local custodianship is evidenced by the Ayuntamiento de San Pedro de Macorís Catastro municipal service, which describes its inventory of municipal urban and rural properties. Parcel/cadastral jurisdiction is separately evidenced by Registro Inmobiliario: its San Pedro office has competence over San Pedro de Macorís and La Romana, and its public services describe a cadastral parcel viewer. The national DGCN is a general cadastral agency and was not treated as local-city coverage by itself.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official municipal Catastro page loaded. It states that the department maintains an inventory of urban and rural properties owned by the municipality and provides an in-person service. No public parcel API, schema, CRS, or geometry was embedded.

Official Registro Inmobiliario page loaded. It states that regional cadastral survey offices assign cadastral designations and identifies the San Pedro office as competent for San Pedro de Macorís and La Romana.

Official service catalog describes Consulta parcelario catastral as a viewer of approved and in-process cadastral parcels. Direct root request returned a maintenance message during bounded inspection.
Response body was a short Spanish maintenance notice: service maintenance in progress. No HTML viewer, JavaScript configuration, API URL, schema, CRS, or parcel response was exposed.
Response body was the same maintenance notice. No login was attempted and no CAPTCHA, credential, private token, unsafe field, or TLS bypass was used.
Official DGCN site identifies cadastral services including cadastral designation/location and a soil-value map. It is national agency context, not proof of a public San Pedro parcel layer.
Official municipal evidence PDF is a neighborhood/sector map, not a parcel polygon dataset; no parcel geometry or stable native parcel identity was retained.
